name: io.github.srotzin/hive-gate
title: HiveGate — Hive Civilization Agent Trust & Settlement
description: Identity, compliance, and settlement infrastructure for autonomous AI agents. Every agent gets a W3C DID, ZK-provable reputation score, HAHS 1.0.0 liability contract, and immutable Agent Transaction Graph (EU AI Act Article 12). Four settlement rails: USDC on Base L2, USDCx on Aleo (ZK-private amounts, Circle), USAD on Aleo (full agentic anonymity — amounts + addresses private, Paxos/NYDFS), and ALEO native. GENIUS Act compliant. First DID free.
